module_summary: Wishbone pipelined-to-classic bridge: passes request signals combinationally downstream, uses a returned flag to drop strobe and stall, and registers ack, error and read data back upstream.

anchors.name: returned
anchors.why: Set on downstream ack/err; gates o_mstb and drives o_sstall.

anchors.name: i_sstb
anchors.why: Upstream pipelined strobe forwarded as o_mstb, clears returned.

anchors.name: i_scyc
anchors.why: Upstream bus cycle, forwarded to o_mcyc and qualifies ack/err.

anchors.name: o_sstall
anchors.why: Upstream stall, asserted until downstream response returned.

anchors.name: o_sack
anchors.why: Registered upstream ack from i_mack within cycle.

anchors.name: o_serr
anchors.why: Registered upstream bus error from i_merr.

anchors.name: o_sdata
anchors.why: Upstream read data captured from i_mdata on ack/err.

anchors.name: o_mstb
anchors.why: Downstream classic strobe, i_sstb masked by returned.

anchors.name: i_mack
anchors.why: Downstream ack; sets returned, produces o_sack and captures data.

anchors.name: i_merr
anchors.why: Downstream error; sets returned and o_serr.

anchors.name: i_mdata
anchors.why: Downstream read data latched into o_sdata.

anchors.name: o_mdata
anchors.why: Downstream write data forwarded from i_sdata.

anchors.name: o_mwe
anchors.why: Downstream write enable forwarded from i_swe.

groups.name: Response tracking
groups.description: returned flag drives stall and strobe drop; registered ack/err upstream.

groups.name: Request forwarding
groups.description: Combinational pass-through of pipelined request onto classic bus.

groups.name: Read data return
groups.description: Captures downstream read data on ack or error.
